text: 恒指收跌1.26%，恒科指跌2.36%。成交额居前个股中，阿里巴巴-W跌6.76%，腾讯控股跌2.64%，中芯国际跌0.53%，华虹宏力涨2.46%，长飞光纤光缆跌6.24%。
text_en: The Hang Seng Index closed down 1.26%, and the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 2.36%. Among the most actively traded stocks, Alibaba-W fell 6.76%, Tencent Holdings fell 2.64%, SMIC fell 0.53%, Hua Hong Semiconductor rose 2.46%, and YOFC fell 6.24%.
